title: Greenhouse — Yasnaya Polyana
visualBrief: Complete original medium-fi greenhouse exterior: log base on pale plinth, genuinely transparent gable panes and glazed end, timber rafters/purlins, two opening roof lights, boarded entry/fuel bay with open wooden door, coarse split-log alcove, opposite-end pale chimney and supported threshold. Simple inner benches are reconstructed for the clear-roof view. Reuse existing wood_log, wood_plain, wood_vertical, plaster_lime and stone_limestone graphs plus a texture-free clear-glass material; no private atlas, copied photograph pixels, flowers, trees or people baked into the building.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained independent15.05x5.72m PMTiles outline matches the public mapped way220075398, visibly named Теплица with building=greenhouse and building:levels=1. Four ordinary museum photos show long log base, glazed gable roof, timber entry/fuel bay at one end and pale chimney at the other. No visitor-map schematic coordinate is used as WGS84. Native X northeast follows the mapped long axis; source axes are baked with heading0. Long glazed garden face assigned local+Z southeast, entry bay at+X northeast and chimney at-X southwest; this absolute photo-side assignment is approximate.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Photo-led one-story scale: low log body1.25m above floor, glazed gable ridge3.15m, chimney4.12m, timber entry/fuel bay2.2m long, real .88x1.95m doorway with leaf open90degrees. Floor 0.7182087492670064m above outside datum; original corner grades 0.568/0.230/0.165/0.465m. Floor is.15m above highest sampled corner; small plinth/foundation follows the standard terrain. Bay widths, roof pitch, vent positions, fuel census and inner benches remain reconstructed.
